modules.name: Amortization
modules.description: Verbtronic-style digital reverb: Verb and Tronic algorithms, tonal tilt, feedback, mode gate and wet-only output

modules.name: Audit Logic
modules.description: Modular in a Week logic: four gates (inverter, AND, OR, XOR, NAND), a 4066 gated switch pair and the Emiz CV2 clock divider

modules.name: Collusion
modules.description: Six coupled LFOs: a Kuramoto swarm that locks or scatters on one knob, with a Benjolin rungler reading out what they agree on

modules.name: Consolidation
modules.description: Modular in a Week mixer and multiples: four-channel mixer with normal and inverted sums, plus buffered and passive-style multiples

modules.name: Bailout
modules.description: Consolidation doubled: eight-channel mixer as two banks of four with their own mixes and a main, per-channel VCAs and direct outs, plus two 1-in-7 multiples

modules.name: Deduction
modules.description: Modular in a Week filter bank: PAiA 2720-3L, Escobedo Q&D, Korg35, MS-20 OTA, EFM Moog high-pass and Synthrotek DIRT, one model at a time

modules.name: Dependents
modules.description: A chord made by distorting one inaudible sine: Chebyshev harmonic exciters tuned to just triads, with a morph between two chords

modules.name: Diversified
modules.description: Modular in a Week effects: the DSP99 program bank plus Echomatic echo, Little Angel chorus, spring reverb, MXR Distortion+, Talk Funny, bitcrusher and 4011 ring modulator

modules.name: Dividend
modules.description: Pulsar-synthesis VCO: pulsaret trains with formant, duty, masking and stochastic payout

modules.name: Garnishment
modules.description: Modular in a Week dual VCA: per channel an LM13700 OTA, a vactrol or a JFET I-AM-O amplitude modulator, with bias, lag and CV amount

modules.name: Gross
modules.description: Black-box / gray-box distortion: Wiener-Hammerstein chain with a parametric tanh mapping, dynamic bias and device presets

modules.name: Installment
modules.description: Modular in a Week dual function generator: simple LFO, 13700 VCLFO, dual AR, PHObos AD/AR with looping, and the CV-controlled PWM driver

modules.name: Kickback
modules.description: Modular in a Week drum bank and drum machine: seven modal percussion voices with V/oct, an internal clock and a Euclidean pattern engine

modules.name: PatchAudit
modules.description: Browse Patchstorage and audit patches against your installed modules

modules.name: Payment Schedule
modules.description: Modular in a Week sequencer: Baby8 steps, 4017 sequential switch in both directions, 4031 tap looper and the varimode quantizer

modules.name: Racketeer
modules.description: Electric Intonarumori: a self-sustaining PT2399 noise voice with feedback echo, filter, chopper and CV'd delay time

modules.name: Reconciliation
modules.description: Just-intonation quantizer: Partch's tonality diamond, 43-tone scale and Otonal/Utonal hexads, Wilson's combination product sets, and five published measures of consonance to choose between them

modules.name: Repossession
modules.description: YouTube sampler: paste a link, chop the audio and video into regions, sequence and modulate them, watch the frames

modules.name: Transmittal
modules.description: Video output: takes frames from another module in the plugin and streams them out through ffmpeg as a live HLS playlist, for TouchDesigner and anything else that reads one

modules.name: Retroactive
modules.description: Windowed sample-permutation effect

modules.name: Schedule A
modules.description: Repossession expander: discrete per-step CV inputs and per-step audio outputs for all eight regions

modules.name: Sign Here
modules.description: Modular in a Week controllers: button and pedal, offset-scaler joystick, and four touch pads

modules.name: Six Figures
modules.description: Modular in a Week oscillator bank: six voices, each a 40106 Schmitt, 4069 AAC, 4046 PLL or reverse-avalanche core, with sync, PLL lock-in and a mix

modules.name: Tax Bracket
modules.description: Olegtron R2R: a passive 8-bit resistor ladder that is a DAC, a weighted mixer, an attenuator and a labile multiple at once

modules.name: Toll
modules.description: Struck-metal voice: sixteen modal partials over a membrane, bar, bell or harmonic series, with strike position, mallet hardness and a buzzing second layer

modules.name: Uncertainty Policy
modules.description: Signal-aware knob and cable randomizer that auditions each roll and reverts the ones that kill the sound

modules.name: Volatility
modules.description: Modular in a Week random: 4006 shift-register noise, YASH sample and hold, and the PHObos random gate
